exec: pm.test("Generated ID and trimmed title", () => { pm.expect(task.id).to.be.a("number").and.above(0); pm.expect(task.id).not.to.eql(900); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql("Review assignment"); pm.expect(task.completed).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("Location points to created task", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/tasks/" + task.id));
pm.test("Second generated ID is different", () => { pm.expect(String(task.id)).not.to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("taskId")); pm.expect(task.completed).to.eql(false); });

pm.test("Both tasks are stored", () => { pm.expect(tasks.some(t => String(t.id) === pm.collectionVariables.get("taskId"))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(tasks.some(t => String(t.id) === pm.collectionVariables.get("secondaryId"))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Update preserves path ID", () => { pm.expect(String(task.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("taskId")); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql("Review source and test results"); pm.expect(task.completed).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("Blank title explained", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("must not be blank"));
